verdict.rationale: Slate is a CLI coding agent, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question for it, but the evidence pack never documents a telemetry or usage-tracking setting, flag, or opt-out. The nearest items are the permission controls for agent actions and the diagnostic data attached to user-initiated bug reports. Neither is a telemetry opt-out, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
